title: Not Merit, Not Sin
devanagari: न पुण्यं न पापं न सौख्यं न दुःखं
न मन्त्रो न तीर्थं न वेदा न यज्ञाः।
अहं भोजनं नैव भोज्यं न भोक्ता
iast: na puṇyaṃ na pāpaṃ na saukhyaṃ na duḥkhaṃ
na mantro na tīrthaṃ na vedā na yajñāḥ |
ahaṃ bhojanaṃ naiva bhojyaṃ na bhoktā
translation: I am not merit or sin, not pleasure or pain. I am not mantra, pilgrimage, the Vedas or sacrifice. I am neither the act of eating, nor the food, nor the eater. My form is consciousness and bliss: I am Shiva, I am Shiva.
translation_hi: मैं न पुण्य हूँ न पाप, न सुख न दुःख। न मंत्र, न तीर्थ, न वेद, न यज्ञ। मैं न भोजन हूँ, न भोज्य, न भोक्ता। मेरा स्वरूप चेतना और आनंद है: मैं शिव हूँ, मैं शिव हूँ।

words.note: Literally 'a crossing place' on a river.

grammar: One root, three roles: √भुज् gives भोजन (the act), भोज्य (the object, 'to be eaten') and भोक्ता (the doer). Sanskrit builds whole word families this way.
Agent noun -tṛ: भोक्तृ → भोक्ता, like भर्तृ in Tāṇḍava verse 4.
Refrain: चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् 'My form is consciousness and bliss. I am Shiva, I am Shiva.'
